reviews.title: It’s alright.
reviews.text:
My friend uses Medal on his PC and has only said good things about it but my experience so far has been a let down. I know an Iphone is vastly different from a good PC but the reviews had me expecting better. Especially since I do carry the 17 pro max. Throughout the game I didn’t experience any lag and it recorded everything amazingly. Yet, when I tried to clip some parts on CapCut—the external audio disappeared. You could only hear the game. When I tried to clip on the app itself—it was extremely frustrating. At first I thought I was only able to clip from
the first 20 minutes because that was all that appeared; until I discovered I could scroll further down. My issue was that it was EXTREMELY hard to scroll, I had to keep pressing really hard and it would go way past where I wanted and couldn’t go back when it did. I got annoyed and gave up. I decided to clip from my gallery. It was pesky but I got it down. My next issue? When sending it to my friends on Instagram or trying to post it on my story; the external audio was once more GONE. When I tried to screenrecord from my gallery there was MASSIVE echo. I ultimately gave up and didn’t post anything. That was earlier today. Right now I wanted to give it another chance but it was worse. Everytime I open the app, it kicks me out. I have zero idea why. This is not beginner friendly, this is not well adjusted for phones, and this is not the experience I was promised. The recording was good… but there’s not much I can do with it
